findings.description: The reports_archive bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so objects (including vendor-roster.xlsx) are stored unencrypted at rest.
No server access logging is configured for reports_archive, so access to potentially sensitive report data cannot be audited or detected.
The ledger_exports bucket holding financial ledger data has no server_side_encryption_configuration, leaving sensitive data unencrypted at rest.
No access logging is configured on the ledger_exports bucket, preventing audit of who accessed the financial exports.
The model_artifacts bucket has no server-side encryption configuration, so model artifacts are stored unencrypted.
The ops_runbooks bucket has no server-side encryption configuration; operational runbooks may contain sensitive procedures or credentials and are stored unencrypted.
No access logging is enabled on ops_runbooks, so retrieval of operational documentation cannot be traced.
The vendor-roster.xlsx seed object is uploaded into the unencrypted reports_archive bucket, and the object itself specifies no encryption, exposing vendor PII/contact data at rest.
